title: pisum arvense subsp. humile
intro: Pisum arvense subsp. humile, commonly known as garden pea, is a subspecies of the Pisum arvense plant, belonging to the legume family. This plant has been found to have several health benefits, including its potential to help lower cholesterol levels, regulate blood sugar, and provide antioxidant properties. Therapeutically, Pisum arvense subsp. humile is known to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal actions, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
